EVIDENCE & DECISIONSMethod guide · 3 min read

An evidence-to-decision checklist.

Five questions to ask before treating a convincing analysis as a decision-ready one.

Method guide
Syful Hoque
01

What question does this evidence answer?

Be specific about the decision and the population or context the findings apply to.

02

What is observed, assumed or estimated?

Keep these categories distinct. Trace important numbers back to their source or calculation.

03

What would change the conclusion?

Test plausible alternatives, uncertain inputs and competing explanations.

04

Who needs to act?

Identify the institution, incentives, capacity and authority required to carry the decision forward.

05

What will tell us whether it works?

Choose practical results measures, specify the baseline and decide how learning will feed back into implementation.

All method guides

Bring the decision you need to defend.

A TOR to staff, a feasibility study to prepare, a model to review or a study to commission.
